UnitAbilities.Title: Invulnerable Save
UnitAbilities.Text: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save.

UnitAbilities.Title: Cold and Calculating
UnitAbilities.Text:
In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to attack, you can select one of the following for this unit’s attacks to have:


- [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].
- Or: [Sustained Hits 1: non-[Monster/Vehicle]
- Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for this unit, [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle] and [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle]

UnitAbilities.Title: Cerebrex Logic Engine
UnitAbilities.Text: In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select one friendly **ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit. That unit has Scouts 6".

UnitAbilities.Title: Rites of Tempering
UnitAbilities.Text: Attacks that target this unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

UnitAbilities.Title: Iron Father
UnitAbilities.Text: While this model is within 3" of a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit, this model has Lone Operative.

UnitAbilities.Title: Master of the Forge
UnitAbilities.Text:
In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model within 3" of this model:


- That Vehicle model heals 3 wounds.
- That Vehicle model’s attacks can ignore modifiers to the following until the start of your next Movement phase:
- BS.
- Hit rolls and wound rolls.

Rule.Title: Codex Discipline
Rule.Text: You can select one Combat Doctrine one additional time per battle.

Adeptus Astartes model only. This model's melee attacks have:
▪ +1S and AP

Enhancements.Name: Adept of the Codex
Enhancements.Description: Captain model only. The tactical doctrine is active for this unit in addition to any other combat doctrine

Enhancements.Name: Standard of the Emperor Ascendant
Enhancements.Description:
Ancient Model only. This model has:
▪ +1OC and Ld
▪ Feel No Pain 5+
▪ The following ability:
Ancient Exhortation (Once per battle, per army). When this unit is selected to fight, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit's melee attacks have +1A until the end of the phase.

Rule.Title: Ironstorm Auto-Targeters
Rule.Text:
Friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle units' (excluding Walker units) ranged attacks can:
▪ Re-roll one hit roll
▪ Re-roll one wound roll

Enhancements.Name: Gunnery Honours (Upgrade)
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit only (excluding Dedicated Transport/Fly/Walker units). This unit's ranged attacks have [Heavy]

Enhancements.Description:
Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit only (excluding Dedicated Transport/Fly/Walker units) This unit:
▪ Has a 5+ InvSv

Rule.Text: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder units have +2"M

Enhancements.Name: Supercharged Engines (Upgrade)
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit only. This unit can re-roll advance rolls.

Enhancements.Name: Auspex Triangulation Shrines (Upgrade)
Enhancements.Description:
Adeptus Astartes Speeder unit only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit. That enemy is spotted.
▪ While a unit is spotted, that unit has +3" detection range

Enhancements.Name: Furious Assault (Upgrade)
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit only. This unit's melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle]

Rule.Text: You can select the Tactical Doctrine one additional time.

Enhancements.Name: Laurels of Vigilance
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes model only. (Once per battle round per army) When you use the Fire Overwatch/Heroic Intervention stratagem, if you target a friendly Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit within 12" of this model with that stratagem, that use is -1CP

Enhancements.Description:
Adeptus Astartes model only.
▪ This unit's ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits]
▪ If the devastator doctrine is active for this unit, this unit can re-roll advance rolls.

Enhancements.Name: Master-Forged Firearms
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted model only. This model's ranged attacks (excluding [Psychic] attacks) have +1A, S, AP and D.

Rule.Title: Death Blow
Rule.Text: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Terminator units have +1 to charge rolls

Enhancements.Name: Champion of the First Company
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. This unit's melee attacks have [Lethal Hits]

Enhancements.Name: Corporeum Reliquary
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

Rule.Title: Wrath of the Chapter
Rule.Text: Friendly Tacticus units can re-roll advance rolls.

Enhancements.Description:
Tacticus model only. This unit's attacks can:

Enhancements.Description: Tacticus model only. This unit has Scouts 6"

Rule.Title: Codex Fire-Patterns
Rule.Text: Friendly Tacticus units [Rapid Fire] attacks benefit from [Rapid Fire] when targeting units up to that attack's maximum range.

Enhancements.Name: Cyber Familiar
Enhancements.Description: Tacticus model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Adeptus Astartes units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

Enhancements.Name: Tempered in Battle (Aura)
Enhancements.Description: Tacticus model only. Friendly Adeptus Astartes units within 6" of this model can re-roll leadership rolls.

Rule.Title: Shadow Masters
Rule.Text:
When a Phobos or Scout Squad unit has shot:
▪ Those attacks do not prevent that unit from being hidden
▪ Or: That unit can make a normal move of up to D6". That unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

Enhancements.Name: Execute and Redeploy
Enhancements.Description: Phobos model only. In your shooting phase, after this unit has shot, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move of up to 6". If it does, this unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

Enhancements.Name: Venator Omni-Auspex
Enhancements.Description:
Phobos model only. This unit's attacks that target a hidden units can:
▪ Re-roll wound rolls of 1
▪ Or: If the assault  doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll wound rolls of 1 and 2

Rule.Title: Vanguard Ambushers
Rule.Text: At the end of your Movement phase, if a friendly Phobos unit is hidden, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.

Enhancements.Name: Seal of Shrouding
Enhancements.Description: Phobos model only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

Enhancements.Name: Venator Omni-Auspex
Enhancements.Description:
Phobos model only. This unit's attacks that target a hidden units can:
▪ Re-roll wound rolls of 1
▪ Or: If the assault  doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll wound rolls of 1 and 2

Rule.Title: Walking Fortress
Rule.Text:
In a turn a friendly Gravis unit made a normal move, that unit's ranged attacks:
▪ Do not have [Heavy]
▪ Have +1 to hit rolls

Enhancements.Description: Gravis model only. Attacks that target this unit with a S greater than this unit's T have -1 to wound rolls.

Enhancements.Name: Relentless Advance

Rule.Title: Indomitable Defence

Enhancements.Description: Gravis unit only. This unit has +1 OC

Enhancements.Name: Narthecis Gauntlet
Enhancements.Description: Apothecary Biologis model only. In your Command phase, this unit heals D3+1 wounds.

Rule.Title: Enduring Vengeance
Rule.Text: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought units can re-roll hit rolls of 1

Enhancements.Description: Dreadnought unit only. Attacks that target this unit have -1D

Enhancements.Description: Dreadnought unit only. While a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit is within 6" of this unit, that unit's attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1

Rule.Title: Combined Deployment
Rule.Text:
In your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is assailed until the end of the turn.
▪ While a unit is assailed, when an Adeptus Astartes unit that disembarked this turn targets that unit, those attacks have [Sustained Hits 1]

Enhancements.Name: Linebreaker Onslaught
Enhancements.Description:
Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only. If this unit disembarked this turn:
▪ This unit can re-roll charge rolls
▪ Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

Enhancements.Name: Damocles-Class Uplink
Enhancements.Description: Captain model only. In your Movement phase, if this unit is embarked within a Transport unit, you can select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit within 6" of that Transport unit and select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for that Infantry unit.

Rule.Title: New Rule
Rule.Text:
Each time a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot or selected to fight apply one of the following when resolving those attacks:


▪ If that unit is within 6" of a friendly Cannok Var/Iron Father Feirros unit you can:
  ▪ Re-roll one hit roll.
  ▪ Re-roll one wound roll.
  ▪ Re-roll one damage roll.
▪ Otherwise you can:
  ▪ Re-roll one hit roll.
  ▪ Or: Re-roll one wound roll.
  ▪ Or: Re-roll one damage roll.

Enhancements.Name: Adept of the Omnissiah
Enhancements.Description: TECHMARINE model only. (Once per battle round, per army) When an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit within 6” of this unit, you can use this ability. If you do, that VEHICLE unit has Feel No Pain 5+ until that enemy unit has attacked.

Enhancements.Name: Master of the Machine War
Enhancements.Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. In your Movement phase, you can select one visible friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit within 6” of this model and then select the devastator doctrine or tactical doctrine. That doctrine is active for that VEHICLE unit until the start of your next Command phase.

Enhancements.Name: Target Augury Web
Enhancements.Description: TECHMARINE model only. In your movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model within 3" of this unit. That VEHICLE model’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS] until the start of your next Command phase

Enhancements.Name: The Flesh is Weak
Enhancements.Description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model:


▪ Has +1 T.
▪ Has Feel No Pain 5+.

Rule.Title: Mission Tactics
Rule.Text:
Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability have the following abilities:


Furor Tactics: If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].


Malleus Tactics: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS].


Purgatus Tactics: If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of this unit have [PRECISION].


DEATHWATCH ALLIES


You can include Deathwatch units in your army, even though they do not have the same Chapter faction keyword as other units in your army. The combined points value of such units cannot exceed 500 points.


When mustering your army, unless otherwise stated, you cannot select a Deathwatch model to be your Warlord. In addition Kill Team units can only contain enhancements taken from this detachment.
